note: This feature has no admin-review/approval lifecycle (S2/S3/S4 are unused) — the meaningful states are S0 (wishlist doesn't yet contain the item under test) and S1 (it does). Nearly all journeys share ONE pre-existing authenticated customer account (tests/.auth/customer.json) rather than a fresh namespaced entity per journey, so most journeys are SERIAL_ONLY to avoid item-count races against the same account — the opposite default from b2b-registration, where each journey got its own isolated customer.
